verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Poke publishes an llms.txt at https://poke.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at a first-party agent-oriented index. However, the probe shows only a truncated product description, so the file's depth and coverage are unverified. Other agent-oriented formats were also not found: /docs.md and every OpenAPI candidate path returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt comprehensively indexes the docs (API, MCP, recipes), markdown versions of the doc pages, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://poke.com/llms.txt # Poke
